title: John Thune re-elected as US Senate Republican leader after midterm losses
english: Senator John Thune has been re-elected as the leader of the U.S. Senate Republicans, running without any opposition despite internal party concerns. Some members had pushed to delay the vote to reflect on significant losses during the recent midterm elections, but no alternative candidates emerged. Thune will continue to lead the Senate Republican Conference as the party prepares to transition into the minority in the upcoming Congress.
amharic: ሴናተር ጆን ትዩን ምንም አይነት ተቀናቃኝ ሳይገጥማቸው በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ የሴኔት ሪፐብሊካን መሪ ሆነው እንደገና ተመረጡ። አንዳንድ የፓርቲው አባላት በቅርቡ በተካሄደው የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ ለደረሰው ሽንፈት በቂ ግምገማ እንዲደረግ ምርጫውን ለማዘግየት ቢሞክሩም፣ ሌሎች እጩዎች ባለመቅረባቸው ድምፅ አሰጣጡ ተካሂዷል። ትዩን በቅርቡ በሚመጣው ኮንግረስ ፓርቲያቸው በአናሳነት ደረጃ ላይ በሚሆንበት ጊዜ አመራራቸውን ይቀጥላሉ።
oromo: Senator John Thune mormitu tokkollee osoo hin qunnamin geggeessaa paartii Rippabilikaanii kan seeneetii Ameerikaa ta'anii filatamaniiru. Miseensonni paartichaa tokko tokko bu'aa gad aanaa filannoo giddu galeessaa darbe irratti mari'achuuf filannoo kana tursiisuu barbaadanii turan, garuu dorgomtootni biroo waan hin dhihaanneef Thune filatamaniiru. Thune, koongeeressii dhufu keessatti paartiin isaanii harka caaluu dhabee yeroo itti hir'atu kanatti geggeessummaa isaanii itti fufu.

title: Russia-Ukraine talks in UAE secure major prisoner exchange deal
english: Russia and Ukraine recently completed a significant prisoner swap following two days of negotiations in the United Arab Emirates. The talks were facilitated by the United States to encourage dialogue between the two nations. However, the discussions did not result in a broader peace agreement, as both sides still hold conflicting views regarding territory and future security issues.
amharic: ሩሲያ እና ዩክሬን በተባበሩት አረብ ኢምሬቶች ባደረጉት የሁለት ቀን ድርድር ትልቅ የ እስረኞች ልውውጥ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። ድርድሩ በአሜሪካ አደራዳሪነት የተካሄደ ቢሆንም፣ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ሰላም ለማስፈን የሚያስችል ስምምነት ላይ መድረስ አልተቻለም። አሁንም ድረስ በግዛት ይገባኛል እና በደህንነት ጉዳዮች ላይ ያላቸው ልዩነት ስላልተፈታ ጦርነቱ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Raashiyaan fi Yuukreen biyyoota Emireetota Araba Gamtoomaniitti guyyoota lamaaf erga mari'atanii booda, wal-jijjiirraa hidhattootaa gurguddaa ta'e irratti waliigalan. Mariin kun kan geggeeffame gargaarsa Ameerikaatiin yoo ta'u, garuu walitti bu'iinsa jidduu isaanii jiru furuuf waliigaltee tokkotti dhufuu hin dandeenye. Dhimmi biyyoota lamaanii irratti walii galuu dhabuun fi dhimmi nageenyaa gara fuulduraa xumura waaraa waan hin arganneef, waraanni sun ammas itti fufee jira.

title: Palestinian American activist refused UK entry for Gaza fundraiser
english: A Palestinian American activist named Mo Hamzeh is threatening legal action against the British government after his travel authorization was revoked before a charity event for Gaza in London. Hamzeh intends to challenge the decision unless officials provide a valid explanation for blocking his entry. Reports indicate that a pro-Israel advocacy group actively campaigned to prevent him from entering the country.
amharic: ሞ ሃምዜ የተባሉ ፍልስጤማዊ አሜሪካዊ አክቲቪስት በለንደን ለጋዛ በሚደረግ የገቢ ማሰባሰቢያ ፕሮግራም ላይ ለመገኘት ሲጓዙ የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም መንግሥት የመግቢያ ፈቃዳቸውን በመሰረዙ ክስ ለመመስረት ዝተዋል። አክቲቪስቱ መንግሥት ለዚህ ውሳኔ በቂ ምክንያት ካልሰጠ ህጋዊ እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ አስታውቀዋል። አንድ እስራኤልን የሚደግፍ ቡድን ግለሰቡ ወደ አገሪቱ እንዳይገቡ ዘመቻ ማድረጉ ተነግሯል።
oromo: Hojjettaan mirga namoomaa kan biyya Ameerikaa fi Falastiinii kan ta'an Mo Hamzeh, dhaabbata gargaarsaa Gazaaf Londonitti qophaa'e irratti argamuuf yeroo turanitti mootummaan UK hayyama seenuu isaanii waan haqeef seeraan gaafachuuf karoorfataniiru. Hamzeh mootummaan sababa gahaa hin dhiyeessine yoo ta'e tarkaanfii seeraa fudhachuu akka barbaadan ibsaniiru. Gareen Israa'eliin deggeru tokko imalli isaanii akka fashaluuf duula godhaa akka turan gabaafameera.

title: Israeli army kills Palestinian footballer Mahmoud Kamal Abdel-Malek in Gaza
english: Mahmoud Kamal Abdel-Malek, a 20-year-old goalkeeper and captain for the Gaza Sports Club, was killed in an Israeli air strike. His death occurred shortly after he participated in the Thousand Martyrs Cup, a tournament dedicated to the many athletes who have lost their lives in the ongoing conflict. This tragedy adds to the high toll of sports figures killed in Gaza, raising further criticism regarding FIFA's lack of action against the Israeli Football Association.
amharic: የጋዛ ስፖርት ክለብ ግብ ጠባቂ እና ካፒቴን የሆነው የ20 ዓመቱ ማህሙድ ከማል አብደል-ማሊክ በእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት መገደሉ ተረጋግጧል። ወጣቱ ስፖርተኛ የተገደለው በጋዛ በተካሄደው 'የሺህ ሰማዕታት ዋንጫ' ውድድር ላይ ከተሳተፈ ጥቂት ቀናት በኋላ ነው። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት በጦርነቱ ህይወታቸውን ያጡ የስፖርት ሰዎች ቁጥር መጨመሩን የሚያሳይ ሲሆን፣ በፊፋ ላይ የሚሰነዘረውን ትችትም አባብሶታል።
oromo: Kabajaa fi eegduun goolii garee ispoortii Gaaza kan ta'e, Maahmuud Kamaal Abdeel-Maalik, haleellaa xiyyaaraa Israa'el mudateen lubbuun isaa darbeera. Dargaggeessi kun kan ajjeefame, taphattoota waraana keessatti lubbuun darbe yaadachuuf qophaa'e 'Wancaa Areeba 1,000' irratti hirmaatee guyyoota muraasa boodadha. Duuti isaa kun lakkoofsa ispoorteessitoota Gaaza keessatti ajjeefamanii kan dabale yoo ta'u, mormii irratti FIFA'n Israa'el irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuu dhabuu isaa ilaalchisee jiru daran hammaachiseera.

title: ‘It’s just too expensive’: Housing and wages at the heart of Spain’s strike
english: Spain is experiencing its first general strike in 14 years as citizens protest against the nation's severe housing crisis and stagnant wages. Protesters are demanding more affordable living conditions, fueled by anger over rising evictions and the fact that rent costs consume almost an entire monthly salary for many young workers. The nationwide movement highlights a deep frustration with the current economic reality, where basic needs like shelter and food have become unsustainable for the average person.
amharic: ስፔን ላለፉት 14 ዓመታት ታይቶ በማይታወቅ መልኩ በሀገር አቀፍ ደረጃ በአድማ እየተናጠች ትገኛለች። ተቃዋሚዎቹ ከፍ ያለ የቤት ኪራይ ዋጋን እና ዝቅተኛ ደመወዝን በመቃወም የመኖሪያ ቤት ችግር እንዲፈታ እና ደመወዝ እንዲጨምር እየጠየቁ ነው። በተለይም ወጣቶች ገቢያቸው አብዛኛውን ክፍል ለቤት ኪራይ ማዋላቸው ለኑሮ ውድነቱ ዋና ምክንያት በመሆኑ፣ ዜጎች መሰረታዊ ፍላጎቶቻቸውን ማሟላት እየተሳናቸው መሆኑን በመግለጽ ተቃውሟቸውን እያሰሙ ነው።
oromo: Ispeeniin waggoota 14 keessatti yeroo jalqabaaf hiriira mormii biyyoolessaa ishee isa guddaa gaggeessaa jirti. Hiriirtonni rakkoo mana jireenyaa fi kaffaltii mindaa gadi aanaa mormuun, gabaasni mana jireenyaa akka hir’atu fi mindaan akka dabalamu gaafachaa jiru. Keessattuu dargaggoonni mindaa isaanii irraa harka caalu mana kireeffachuuf waan baasaniif, jireenyi guyyuu fi nyaatni ga’aa ta’e dhabamee akka jiru ibsaniiru.

title: Vinícius Jr sends message to Sudan boy who received prosthetic legs after BBC report sparks appeal
english: A 13-year-old Sudanese boy named Zaher, who lost both legs in a drone strike, has successfully received prosthetic limbs and undergone rehabilitation in Cairo. After a BBC report highlighted his difficult journey and love for football, Real Madrid star Vinícius Jr sent him a heartfelt personal video message. The footballer praised Zaher's resilience and invited him to attend a future Real Madrid match together.
amharic: በሱዳን የድሮን ጥቃት ሁለቱን እግሮቹን ያጣው ዛሄር የተባለ የ13 ዓመት ልጅ በካይሮ አስፈላጊውን ህክምና በማግኘት ሰው ሰራሽ እግሮችን ተከላ ተንቀሳቅሷል። የቢቢሲ ዘገባ ስለ ልጁ ሁኔታ መዘገቡን ተከትሎ፣ የሪያል ማድሪዱ ኮከብ ቪኒሲየስ ጁኒየር ለልጁ የቪዲዮ መልእክት በመላክ አበረታቶታል። ታዋቂው አትሌት የልጁን ብርታት በማድነቅ ወደፊት የሪያል ማድሪድ ጨዋታን በአንድ ላይ እንዲመለከቱ ጋብዞታል።
oromo: Mucaan umuriin isaa 13 fi Sudaan irraa dhufe Zaher jedhamu, haleellaa diroonii irra gaheen miila lamaanuu erga dhabee booda, Kaayiroo keessatti miila sobaa argatee deebi'ee deemuuf danda'eera. Gabaasni BBC rakkoo mucichaa fi jaalala inni kubbaa miilaaf qabu erga ifa baasee booda, taphataan beekamaan Real Madrid Viinisiyas Juuniyeer ergaa viidiyoos isaaf ergeera. Taphataan kun jabina mucichaa dinqisiifachuu bir darbee, gara fuulduraatti tapha Real Madrid waliin akka ilaalaniif afeereera.

title: Headquarters of Haitian gang destroyed, El Salvador's president says
english: El Salvador’s military recently launched an air and ground attack in Haiti, reportedly destroying the main headquarters of the notorious 400 Mawozo gang. President Nayib Bukele announced the operation on social media, claiming that gang members fled the scene during the strikes near Port-au-Prince. This action is part of a broader mission involving over 2,000 Salvadoran soldiers currently in Haiti to address gang violence and search for missing citizens.
amharic: የኤል ሳልቫዶር ወታደሮች በሄይቲ የሚገኘውን ታዋቂው የ400 ማዎዞ ቡድን ዋና መሥሪያ ቤት በአየር እና በየብስ ጥቃት ማውደማቸውን የሀገሪቱ ፕሬዝዳንት አስታውቀዋል። ፕሬዝዳንት ናይብ ቡኬሌ በሰጡት መግለጫ ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው በፖርት ኦ-ፕሪንስ ዳርቻ ሲሆን የቡድኑ አባላትም ያለ ምንም ተጋድሎ መሸሻቸውን ገልጸዋል። ይህ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ በሀገሪቱ የጠፉ ዜጎችን ለመፈለግ እና የወንጀል ቡድኖችን ለመቆጣጠር በሄይቲ ከሚገኙ ከ2,000 በላይ የኤል ሳልቫዶር ወታደሮች ተልዕኮ አካል ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan El Salvador humna waraanaa isaa fayyadamudhaan, bulchiinsa magaalaa Hayitii keessatti bakka buufata garee yakka hamaa '400 Mawozo' barbadeessuu isaa beeksiseera. Pirezidaantiin El Salvador Nayib Bukele akka jedhanitti, haleellaa xiyyaaraa fi lafarra taasifameen miseensonni garee sanaa osoo hin loogin bakkichaa baqataniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun qondaaltota El Salvador kanneen dhabaman barbaaduu fi nageenya Hayitii eeguuf gara biyyattii ergame keessaa kutaa tokko dha.

title: Pakistan women’s captain Fatima Sana calls for gender equality in cricket
english: Pakistan women's cricket captain Fatima Sana is advocating for equal recognition and support for female cricketers in her country. She encouraged fans to show the same level of enthusiasm and attendance at women’s matches as they do for the men’s team. Currently competing in Australia's Big Bash League, Sana hopes her international experiences will inspire more Pakistani girls to pursue professional cricket.
amharic: የፓኪስታን የሴቶች የክሪኬት ቡድን ካፒቴን ፋጢማ ሳና በሀገሯ ለሴት ተጫዋቾች እኩል ክብር እና ድጋፍ እንዲኖር ትጠይቃለች። ደጋፊዎች ለወንዶች ቡድን እንደሚሰጡት ሁሉ ለሴቶች የክሪኬት ግጥሚያዎችም ተመሳሳይ ፍቅር እና ተሳትፎ እንዲያሳዩ አሳስባለች። በአሁኑ ወቅት በአውስትራሊያ እየተጫወተች የምትገኘው ፋጢማ፣ ያካበተችው ዓለም አቀፍ ልምድ ለሌሎች የፓኪስታን ልጃገረዶች መነሳሻ በመሆን ስፖርቱን በሀገሯ እንዲያሳድጉ ተስፋ ታደርጋለች።
oromo: Kabtaan garee kirikeetii dubartoota Paakistaan Faatimaa Saanaa, biyya ishee keessatti taphattoota dubartootaaf qixxee ta'ee fi deeggarsa ga’aa akka godhamu gaafatteetti. Deeggartoonni akka garee dhiiraa, gita wal fakkaatuun tapha dubartootaa irratti argamanii akka jajjabeessan waamicha dhiheessiteetti. Yeroo ammaa biyya Awustiraaliyaa keessatti taphataa kan jirtu Faatimaan, muuxannoo ishee kana irraa kan ka'e intallan Paakistaan hedduun gara tapha kanaatti akka dhufan abdiin qaba.

title: Pakistan’s PTI demands access to jailed Khan after overnight hospital visit
english: Former Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan was briefly transferred from prison to a government hospital for specialized eye treatment related to a retinal condition. His political party, the PTI, has expressed significant concern over his health and the lack of transparency regarding the procedure. They are now demanding that his family, personal physicians, and legal representatives be granted immediate and unrestricted access to him.
amharic: የቀድሞው የፓኪስታን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኢምራን ካን ከዓይን ህመም ጋር በተያያዘ ለህክምና በአጭር ጊዜ ከእስር ቤት ወደ የመንግስት ሆስፒታል ተወስደው ተመልሰዋል። የእሳቸው የፖለቲካ ፓርቲ የሆነው ፒቲአይ፣ ስለ ሁኔታው በቂ መረጃ አለመሰጠቱን በመግለጽ ስጋቱን አሳይቷል። ፓርቲው የካን ቤተሰቦች፣ የግል ሀኪሞች እና ጠበቆች ያለምንም ገደብ እንዲጠይቋቸው ጥሪ እያቀረበ ነው።
oromo: Muummeen Ministiraa duraanii Paakistaan Imraan Kaan dhibee ijaa isaanii wal’aanachuuf yeroo gabaabaaf mana hidhaatii gara hospitaala mootummaatti fudhatamanii turan. Paartiin isaanii PTI, waa’ee fayyaa isaanii fi wal’aansa godhameef irratti iftoomni akka hin jirre ibsuun yaaddoo qaban ibsaniiru. Kanaafuu, maatiin isaanii, ogeeyyiin fayyaa fi gorsitoonni seeraa isaanii dafanii akka isaan qunnaman gaafachaa jiru.

title: Gaza Grad: A Palestinian-Russian family’s longing for home
english: A Palestinian-Russian family was forced to flee Gaza following the outbreak of war in October 2023 after initially refusing to leave their home. The family members have since been separated, with some settling in Russia while others moved to Egypt to be geographically closer to their homeland. Their story highlights the painful struggle of balancing the search for safety with the deep desire to return to a place they consider home.
amharic: የፍልስጤም እና የሩሲያ ዝርያ ያለው አንድ ቤተሰብ በጥቅምት 2023 በተቀሰቀሰው ጦርነት ምክንያት ቤታቸውን ለቀው ለመውጣት ተገደዋል። ቤተሰቡ አሁን ተከፋፍሎ በሩሲያ እና በግብፅ የሚኖር ሲሆን፣ ወደ ጋዛ ለመመለስ ያላቸውን ጠንካራ ፍላጎት ይዘው ይገኛሉ። ታሪካቸው የደህንነት ፍለጋ እና ወደ ቀድሞው መኖሪያ ቤት የመመለስ ጉጉት መካከል ያለውን ከባድ ትግል ያሳያል።
oromo: Maatiin lammii Falasxiinii fi Raashiyaa ta'an tokko, waraana Onkoloolessa 2023 ka'e hordofee mana isaanii gadhiisanii baqachuuf dirqamaniiru. Maatiin kun amma bittinnaa'anii biyyoota Raashiyaa fi Gibxii keessa jiraachuun, gara Gaazaatti deebi'uuf abdii guddaa qabu. Seenaan isaanii nageenya argachuu fi gara lafa dhalootaatti deebi'uuf fedhii qaban gidduutti rakkina isaan mudate ibsa.

title: What do Kyiv residents think about giving up territory to Russia?
english: Residents of Kyiv remain firmly opposed to the idea of ceding any Ukrainian territory to Russia to end the ongoing war. Many citizens emphasize that giving up land would not guarantee lasting peace and could instead embolden further aggression. The general sentiment in the capital reflects a strong commitment to reclaiming sovereign territory despite the hardships caused by the conflict.
amharic: የኪዬቭ ነዋሪዎች ጦርነቱን ለማቆም ሲባል ማንኛውንም የዩክሬን መሬት ለሩሲያ የመስጠት ሀሳብን አጥብቀው ይቃወማሉ። ብዙዎቹ ዜጎች መሬት መስጠት ዘላቂ ሰላምን እንደማያመጣ እና ይልቁንም ለተጨማሪ ጥቃት መንገድ ሊከፍት እንደሚችል ይናገራሉ። በዋና ከተማው ያለው አጠቃላይ ስሜት፣ ከጦርነቱ የሚመጡ ችግሮች ቢኖሩም የተያዘውን መሬት መልሶ ለማስመለስ ቁርጠኛ መሆናቸውን ያሳያል።
oromo: jiraattonni magaalaa Kiyiv waraana kana dhaabuuf jecha biyya Yukreen keessaa lafa tokkollee gara Raashiyaatti dabarsanii kennuuf yaada jiru hin deggeran. Namoonni hedduun lafa kennuun nagaa waaraa akka hin fenneefi kanneen biroo akka jajjabeessu dubbatu. Haalli waliigalaa magaala guddittii kanaa, rakkoo waraanni fide hunda keessattuu lafa qabame deeffachuuf murannoo cimaa akka qaban agarsiisa.

title: US embassy refutes Houthis’ Yemen blockade claims, highlights siege on Taiz
english: The US Embassy in Yemen has rejected claims by Houthi rebels that Saudi-led forces are blocking essential imports to their territories. Using UN shipping data, the embassy demonstrated that hundreds of commercial vessels have successfully delivered food and supplies to Houthi-controlled ports throughout 2026. Conversely, the US accused the Houthis of hypocritically maintaining a long-standing siege on the Yemeni city of Taiz.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ኤምባሲ የሁቲ አማጽያን ሳዑዲ የሚመራው ጥምረት ወደ እነሱ ግዛት የሚገቡ እቃዎችን ዘግቷል የሚለውን ክስ ውድቅ አድርጓል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅትን መረጃ በመጥቀስ፣ በ2026 በሙሉ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ የንግድ መርከቦች ምግብ እና መሰረታዊ አቅርቦቶችን ወደ ሁቲ ቁጥጥር ስር ባሉ ወደቦች ማድረሳቸውን ኤምባሲው አስታውቋል። በሌላ በኩል፣ አሜሪካ ሁቲዎች በታኢዝ ከተማ ላይ ከባድ ከበባ በማድረግ ህዝቡን እየጎዱ ነው ስትል ከሳለች።
oromo: Embaasii Ameerikaa kan Yamanitti argamu, gareen Hutiin kanneen mormituun, walta'iinsi Sa'udii durfamu gara naannoo isaaniitti gargaarsa dhorkaa jira jechuun himatan soba jedhe. Embaasiin kun ragaa Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii fayyadamuun, bara 2026 keessa markaaleen daldalaa dhibbaan lakkaa'aman midhaan fi meeshaalee barbaachisoo gara buufataalee Hutiin to'atamanii gahuu isaanii ibse. Kana irra darbee, Ameerikaan gareen Hutiin ofii isaanii magaalaa Ta'izitti marsee akka jiru fi uummata miidhutti akka jiran himatte.

title: Three Iran-backed suspects plotted attacks including RAF Fairford incident, US says
english: The US Department of Justice has charged three individuals linked to Iran for coordinating a series of terrorist plots across Europe and the US. These suspects are accused of directing various attacks, including a security incident at the RAF Fairford air base in the UK and a stabbing in London. While Iran has denied these claims, US officials state that the group operated under a fake name to carry out nearly 20 violent acts on behalf of Iranian-backed organizations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፍትህ ሚኒስቴር በአውሮፓ እና በአሜሪካ የሽብር ጥቃቶችን ለማቀነባበር በኢራን የተደገፉ ሶስት ግለሰቦች ላይ ክስ መስርቷል። ተከሳሾቹ በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም በሚገኘው የRAF Fairford አየር ማረፊያ ላይ ከተፈጸመው ጥርጣሬ እና በለንደን ከተፈጸመው ቢላዋ ጥቃት ጋር ግንኙነት አላቸው ተብሎ ይከሰሳሉ። ኢራን የክሱን ይዘት በጽኑ ብትቃወምም፣ የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ቡድኑ ከ20 በላይ የሚሆኑ የሽብር ተግባራትን በውሸት ስም በመጠቀም ኢራንን በመወከል ለማከናወን መሞከራቸውን ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa qaama haqaa sadtatu garee Iranin deeggaraman irratti erga himannaa banee booda, gareen kun Awurooppaa fi Ameerikaa keessatti shororkeessummaa geggeessaa akka turan beekameera. Himatamtoonni kun buufata xiyyaaraa RAF Fairford kan UK keessatti argamu irratti rakkoo uumuufi magaala London keessatti namoota waraananii miidhuu keessatti harka qabu jedhamee shakkamu. Iran himannaa kana kan haaltu ta'us, qondaalonni Ameerikaa gareen kun maqaa sobaa fayyadamuun gocha shororkeessummaa kudhanneen baay'atu raawwachuuf karoorfachuu isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: US Army soldier suspected of spying for Russia arrested in UK
english: A 41-year-old senior US Army soldier stationed at Imjin Barracks in England has been arrested by British counter-terrorism police on suspicion of spying for Russia. The soldier is accused of illegally obtaining protected information and assisting a foreign intelligence service under the National Security Act. He is currently being held in London while authorities conduct further searches and investigate the serious breach of security.
amharic: በእንግሊዝ በሚገኘው ኢምጂን ባራክስ የጦር ሰፈር ሲያገለግል የነበረ የ41 ዓመት የአሜሪካ ጦር አባል ለሩሲያ ስለላ አድርጓል በሚል በብሪታንያ የፀረ-ሽብር ፖሊስ ተይዟል። ወታደሩ ሚስጥራዊ መረጃዎችን በመስረቅ እና ለውጭ ሀገር የስለላ ተቋም ድጋፍ በማድረግ በአገሪቱ ብሔራዊ ደህንነት ህግ ስር ተጠርጥሯል። በአሁኑ ወቅት ግለሰቡ በለንደን እስር ቤት የሚገኝ ሲሆን፣ ባለስልጣናት በጉዳዩ ላይ ተጨማሪ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Ajajaan waraana Ameerikaa waggaa 41 ta'e kan Ingilizitti buufata waraana Imjin Barracks keessa ture, biyya Rashiyaaf hiddudha (spying) gochuun shakkamee poolisii farra shororkeessitoota Biritishin qabame. Namichi kun odeeffannoo dhoksaa ta'e seeraan ala argachuu fi tajaajila iccitii biyya alaa gargaaruun seera nageenya biyyaa cabsuun shakkama. Ammaaf londan keessatti hidhamee kan jiru yoo ta'u, aangotni dhimma kana irratti qorannoo bal'aa gaggeessaa jiru.

title: US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, for now
english: The US House of Representatives has blocked an attempt by Republican congressman Thomas Massie to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. The motion to remove Hegseth over accusations of unauthorized military action in Iran was sent to a committee, effectively halting the effort before the current congressional session ends. President Trump praised the vote, while Hegseth dismissed the impeachment attempt as a political stunt.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት የመከላከያ ሚኒስትሩን ፒት ሄግሴትን በክስ ለማስወገድ የቀረበውን ጥረት አግዶታል። የሪፐብሊካኑ ኮንግረስ አባል ቶማስ ማሲ ሚኒስትሩ ያለ ኮንግረስ ፈቃድ ኢራን ላይ ጦርነት ከፍተዋል በሚል ያቀረቡት ክስ ወደ ኮሚቴ እንዲዛወር በመደረጉ ጉዳዩ ውድቅ ሆኗል። ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የድምጽ አሰጣጡን ውጤት በደስታ የተቀበሉ ሲሆን፣ ሄግሴትም የቀረበበት ክስ የፖለቲካ ትርኢት እንጂ ሌላ አይደለም ሲሉ አጣጥለውታል።
oromo: Mana Maree Bakka Bu'oota Ummata Amerikaa keessatti, Ministirri Ittisaa Pete Hegseth irratti himata aangoo irraa kaasuu dhihaate hoggantoonni mana marichaa dhaabsisaniiru. Miseensi Kongiresii Rippabilikaanii Thomas Massie, ministirichi hayyama malee Iran irratti waraana baneera jechuun himata kana dhiheessee ture, garuu yaanni kun gara komitiitti ergamee akka gadi dhaabatu ta'eera. Pireezidaant Traamp murtoo kanaan gammachuu isaanii ibsan; Hegseth gamasaaniin himatichi akka waan siyaasaa qofaatti fudhatama akka hin qabne dubbataniiru.

title: 'It can kill us': Kenyans fear impact of El Niño with floods predicted
english: Residents of Kenya's informal settlements, particularly in Kibera, are bracing for severe flooding due to the expected El Niño weather phenomenon. Having suffered tragic losses and destruction during previous rains, many people fear their fragile homes will not withstand the upcoming extreme weather. In response, authorities are cleaning riverbeds and unclogging drainage systems across Nairobi to mitigate the risk of another disaster.
amharic: በኬንያ በተለይም በኪቤራ የሚኖሩ ነዋሪዎች ኤል নিনዮ የተሰኘው የአየር ንብረት ክስተት ሊያስከትል በሚችለው ከፍተኛ ጎርፍ ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ስጋት ውስጥ ናቸው። ከዚህ ቀደም በተከሰቱ የዝናብ አደጋዎች ቤተሰቦቻቸውን ያጡና ንብረታቸው የወደመባቸው ሰዎች፣ አሁን የሚጠበቀው ዝናብ ደካማ ቤቶቻቸውን ሊያፈርስ እንደሚችል ይፈራሉ። መንግስትም አደጋውን ለመቀነስ በናይሮቢ የሚገኙ የውሃ ማስተላለፊያ ቦዮችንና የወንዝ ዳርቻዎችን የማጽዳት ስራዎችን እያከናወነ ይገኛል።
oromo: jiraattonni naannolee baadiyyaa fi magaalaa Keeniyaa, keessattuu Kiberaa, sababa jijjiirama qilleensaa El Niinootiin roobni cimaan dhufuu danda'uuf sodaachaa jiru. Balaa roobaa darbe keessatti lubbuun namoota baay'ee darbee fi manni jireenyaa waan miidhameef, namoonni baay'een manni isaanii laafaa ta'ee fi rooba kana dandamachuu akka hin dandeenye yaaddoo qabu. Kanaan walqabatee, mootummaan balaa uumamu xiqqeessuuf, Naayiroobii keessatti bakkeewwan bishaan itti gadi yaa'u fi qarqara laggeenii qulqulleessuuf carraaqqii gochaa jira.

title: Protesters throw milk at Joe Biden during Hunter event in Dublin
english: During a surprise visit to Trinity College in Dublin, former President Joe Biden was targeted by pro-Palestinian protesters who threw milk at him. The demonstration occurred while he was attending an event to see his son, Hunter, receive an award for public discourse. The protesters aimed to express their opposition to the former president’s support for Israel.
amharic: ቀድሞ የነበሩት ፕሬዝዳንት ጆ ባይደን በደብሊን በሚገኘው ትሪኒቲ ኮሌጅ ባደረጉት ድንገተኛ ጉብኝት ወቅት በፕሮ-ፍልስጤም ተቃዋሚዎች የወተት ጥቃት ተሰንዝሮባቸዋል። ይህ የተቃውሞ ድርጊት የተፈፀመው ልጃቸው ሀንተር የህዝብ ተሳትፎ ሽልማት በሚቀበልበት ስነስርዓት ላይ ባሉበት ወቅት ነው። ተቃዋሚዎቹ ድርጊቱን የፈጸሙት ለኢስራኤል ያላቸውን ድጋፍ ለመቃወም ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin duraanii Joo Baayiden magaala Dabliinitti kutaalee kolleejjii Tiriinitii daawwataa jiranitti, hiriirtonni sagantaa Falastiinii deggaran aannaniin isa irratti darbataniiru. Hiriirri kun kan raawwatame yeroo inni ilma isaa Hantar badhaasa fudhachaa jiru arguu dhaqetti. Hiriirtonni kun kanneen aannanii darbatan kun, inni Israa'el gargaaruu isaa mormuuf akka ta'e ibsameera.

title: Former Iraqi lawmaker Ahmed al-Alwani found dead in Beirut
english: Former Iraqi parliamentarian Ahmed al-Alwani was discovered dead in a Beirut apartment, leading Lebanese authorities to open a murder investigation. Officials believe he was strangled, and one Lebanese suspect has already been taken into custody while the search for two additional individuals continues. Al-Alwani was a prominent Sunni politician known for opposing the Iraqi government and Iranian influence in the region.
amharic: የቀድሞው የኢራቅ ፓርላማ አባል አህመድ አል-አልዋኒ በቤይሩት በሚገኝ አፓርታማ ውስጥ ሞተው ተገኝተዋል፤ የሊባኖስ ባለስልጣናትም ክስተቱን የነፍስ ማጥፋት ወንጀል በማለት ምርመራ ጀምረዋል። ተጎጂው ታንቀው እንደተገደሉ የመጀመሪያ መረጃዎች የሚያመለክቱ ሲሆን፣ አንድ የሊባኖስ ዜጋ በወንጀሉ ተጠርጥሮ በቁጥጥር ስር ውሏል። አል-አልዋኒ በኢራቅ የነበሩ የፖለቲካ ተቃዋሚ እና የኢራንን ተጽእኖ በግልጽ በመቃወም ይታወቁ የነበሩ ሰው ናቸው።
oromo: Miseensi duraanii mana maree bakka buutota ummataa Iraaq kan ta'an Ahmed al-Alwani, magaalaa Beyruutitti mana jireenyaa tokko keessatti du'anii argamuu isaanii hordofee, mootummaan Libaanoos qorannoo ajjeechaa jalqabeera. Qorannoon jalqabaa akka agarsiisutti, namichi kun ukkaamfamanii ajjeefamuun isaanii mirkanaa'ee, namni tokko to'annoo jala ooleera, poolisiin ammoo shakkamtoota biroo lama barbaadaa jira. Al-Alwani siyaasaa biyya Iraaq keessatti gahee guddaa kan qaban yoo ta'u, dhiibbaa Iiraan biyyattii keessatti qabdu mormuudhaan beekamu.

title: US charges 3 ‘Iranian-backed’ men over alleged plot at UK Fairford air base
english: The United States has charged three individuals linked to Iranian-backed groups for allegedly plotting terrorist activities, including a scheme to target the RAF Fairford air base in the UK. Prosecutors claim the suspects were acting on behalf of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps and Kataib Hezbollah to coordinate attacks across the US and Europe. While one suspect is currently detained in New York, the whereabouts of the other two remain unknown.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፍትህ መምሪያ ከኢራን ጋር ግንኙነት አላቸው የተባሉ ሶስት ግለሰቦች ላይ ሽብርተኝነትን በመሰረተ ክስ መስርቷል። ተጠርጣሪዎቹ በእንግሊዝ በሚገኘው የፌርፎርድ አየር ማረፊያ እና በሌሎች የአሜሪካና የአውሮፓ አካባቢዎች የሽብር ጥቃት ለመፈጸም አቅደዋል ተብሎ ተከሷል። አንደኛው ተጠርጣሪ በኒውዮርክ እስር ቤት ውስጥ የሚገኝ ሲሆን የሌሎቹ ሁለቱ ግለሰቦች መገኛ እስካሁን አልታወቀም።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa namoota garee Iran deggaran sadii ta'an irratti qophii shoroorkeessummaa geggeessuu isaanii himatee himata baneera. Namoonni kunneen buufata xiyyaraa RAF Fairford kan UK fi naannawwa biroo Ameerikaa fi Awurooppaa keessatti haleellaa raawwachuuf karoorfataniiru jedhamee shakkamu. Shakkamtoonni kunneen garee IRGC fi Kataib Hezbollah waliin hariiroo akka qaban himameera; shakkamaan tokko New York keessatti yeroo hidhamee jiru, kanneen biroo lama garuu bakki jiran hin beekamu.

title: Republicans block Hegseth impeachment motion
english: Republican lawmakers in the United States have successfully halted a move to impeach Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth. The impeachment attempt was linked to controversies involving military actions against Iran, operations concerning Venezuelan leader Nicolas Maduro, and naval attacks on vessels in the Caribbean. Consequently, the motion will not proceed at this time.
amharic: በአሜሪካ የሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ አባላት የመከላከያ ሚኒስትሩን ፒት ሄግሰትን ለመክሰስ የቀረበውን ጥያቄ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። ይህ ክስ ከኢራን ጋር በተያያዙ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎች፣ ከቬንዙዌላው መሪ ኒኮላስ ማዱሮ ጋር በተገናኘ ጉዳዮች እንዲሁም በካሪቢያን ባህር ውስጥ በተፈጸሙ የባህር ኃይል ጥቃቶች ላይ ያተኮረ ነበር። በዚህም ምክንያት የመክሰስ ሂደቱ እንዲቋረጥ ተደርጓል።
oromo: Miseensoni paartii Rippaabilikaanii kan Ameerikaa, ministeera ittisaa Piit Heegseetiin aangoo irraa kaasuuf dhihaate mormuun dhaabsisaniiru. Yaaliin aangoo irraa kaasuun kun waraana Iiraan, dhimma hogganaa Veenezuweelaa Niikolaas Maaduuroo fi haleellaa markaba naannoo Kaaribiyaanitti raawwatamee wajjin wal qabata. Kanaafuu, dhimmi kun gara fuulduraatti akka hin adeemne murtaa'eera.

title: Tigray displaced families fear renewed war as hopes of returning home fade
english: Families displaced by the Tigray war continue to live in temporary shelters, such as schools, years after fleeing their homes. Although a peace agreement was signed in 2022, unresolved territorial disputes and a recent escalation in fighting have dashed their hopes of returning. Many remain stuck in uncertain conditions as renewed violence threatens the stability of the region.
amharic: በትግራይ ጦርነት ምክንያት የተፈናቀሉ ቤተሰቦች ከቤታቸው ከወጡ ዓመታት ያለፉ ቢሆንም አሁንም በትምህርት ቤቶች እና በጊዜያዊ መጠለያዎች ውስጥ መኖርን ይገደዳሉ። እ.ኤ.አ በ2022 የተፈረመው የሰላም ስምምነት የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ የወሰን ግጭቶች እና በቅርቡ የተቀሰቀሰው አዲስ ውጊያ ወደ ቀያቸው የመመለስ ተስፋቸውን አጨልሞታል። አሁን ባለው የጸጥታ ችግር ምክንያት በርካቶች በከፍተኛ እርግጠኛ ባልሆነ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Maatiin waraana Tigraayiin buqqa’an waggoota hedduu boodas mana barumsaa fi bakkeewwan yeroodhaaf qophaa’an keessa jiraachuu itti fufaniiru. Walii galteen nagaa bara 2022 mallatteeffame iyyuu, dhimmi daangaa fi walitti bu’iinsi dhiyeenya kana dhalate abdii gara manaatti deebi’uu isaanii fageesseera. Waraanni haarome kun nagaa naannichaa waan miidheef, maatiin kunneen haala dhugaatti rakkaachaa fi abdii kutatanii jiru.

title: Analysis: The changing face of Israel’s ultra-Orthodox politics
english: The ultra-Orthodox United Torah Judaism party has signaled a potential shift in Israeli politics by withholding its recommendation for Benjamin Netanyahu to lead the new government. This move highlights internal instability, including challenges to veteran leadership and evolving views among the younger Haredi generation. Recent regional tensions have influenced these communities, suggesting that traditional religious political alliances are no longer guaranteed.
amharic: የእስራኤል እጅግ ኦርቶዶክሳዊ የሆነው የተባበሩት የቶራህ ይሁዲነት ፓርቲ ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ መንግስት እንዲመሰርቱ አለመደገፉ በእስራኤል ፖለቲካ ውስጥ ትልቅ ለውጥ መኖሩን ያሳያል። ይህ ውሳኔ በፓርቲው ውስጥ ያለውን የአመራር ክፍፍል እና የወጣቱ ትውልድ አስተሳሰብ መቀየርን ያንጸባርቃል። በክልሉ የተፈጠሩት ወቅታዊ ሁኔታዎች ባህላዊ የፖለቲካ አጋርነቶችን እየፈተኑ መሆኑን ይህ ክስተት ያሳያል።
oromo: Paartiin ultra-Orthodox kan Yunaaytid Tooraah Yudaayizim jedhamu, Binyamiin Netaanyaahuun mootummaa haaraa akka hundeessan deggeruu dhiisuun isaa jijjiirama siyaasaa Israa'el keessatti mul'achaa jiru argisiisa. Tarkaanfiin kun qeeqa dura buutota paartichaa irratti ka'aa jiru fi jijjiirama yaadaa dhaloota dargaggeessaa keessatti mul'atu agarsiisa. Haalli yeroo ammaa naannichatti uumame, walitti dhufeenyi siyaasaa aadaa ta'e durii ture jijjiirama keessa akka jiru mirkaneessa.

title: US Treasury chief moved to military base after alleged Iranian threats: Report
english: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent was relocated to a military base due to credible threats against him linked to Iran. Intelligence reports indicate that Iranian efforts to target American officials have become more aggressive and are now in advanced phases. The Trump administration is taking these security warnings seriously as they monitor rising threats against US personnel.
amharic: የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ስኮት ቤሰንት ከኢራን የመጡ ስጋቶች በመኖራቸው ወደ ወታደራዊ ካምፕ እንዲዛወሩ ተደርገዋል። የኢንተለጀንስ መረጃዎች እንደሚያሳዩት ኢራን በአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ላይ የምታደርገው ጥቃት እየተጠናከረ እና ወደ ወሳኝ ምዕራፍ መሸጋገሩን ነው። የትራምፕ አስተዳደር በአሜሪካኖች ላይ የተጋረጠውን ይህንን የጸጥታ ስጋት በቁም ነገር በመመልከት ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Ministeerri Bajataa Ameerikaa Iskootti Besent, sodaalee gara Iran irraa dhufaniin walqabatee gara buufata waraanaatti akka jijjiiraman taasifamaniiru. Odeeffannooleen icciitii akka agarsiisanitti, Iran hojjettoota mootummaa Ameerikaa irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuuf yaalii gootu daran dabaluun ishee fi karoorri ishees sadarkaa ol'aana irra gahuun ibsameera. Bulchiinsi Traamp, sodaalee haaraa ba'aa jiran kana irraa ka'uun eegumsa cimaa gochaa jiru.

title: ‘All I can do is hug my children and cry’: Palestinians in Gaza face deadly winter floods
english: Heavy winter rains have caused severe flooding in Gaza, creating dire living conditions for families forced to reside in flimsy tents and damaged buildings. This situation is further aggravated by ongoing restrictions on humanitarian aid, which block the delivery of essential supplies like blankets and repair materials. Many displaced people are struggling to cope as they deal with the dual trauma of extreme weather and limited access to basic survival needs.
amharic: በጋዛ እየዘነበ ያለው ከባድ የክረምት ዝናብና የጎርፍ አደጋ በድንኳንና በተጎዱ ቤቶች ውስጥ ለሚኖሩ ተፈናቃዮች ከፍተኛ ችግር ፈጥሯል። እስራኤል ለሰብአዊ እርዳታ የጣለችው ገደብ ብርድ ልብሶችንና ሌሎች መጠለያዎችን ለመጠገን የሚያስፈልጉ ቁሳቁሶች እንዳይገቡ በማድረጓ ሁኔታውን ይበልጥ አባብሶታል። በችግር ውስጥ ያሉ ቤተሰቦችም በከባድ የአየር ንብረትና በመሠረታዊ የኑሮ ፍላጎቶች እጥረት ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ስቃይ እየደረሰባቸው ይገኛል።
oromo: Roobni cimaa fi lolaan Gaazaatti mudate, maatiiwwan dunkaana fi manneen miidhaman keessa jiraatan irratti rakkoo guddaa uumeera. Hanga ammaa hangafoota gargaarsa namoomaa irratti jirun, meeshaalee akka uffata ho'aa fi bu'uuraalee suphaa akka hin galle dhorkuun isaa rakkinicha hammaachiseera. Namoonni buqqa'an kunneen haala qilleensa hamaa fi dhabama meeshaalee bu'uuraa waliin wal'aansoo godhaa jiru.

title: US Republicans derail bid to impeach Pentagon chief
english: US House Republicans have stopped an attempt to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth by sending the resolution to a committee instead of a floor vote. This move effectively blocks the effort to remove the Pentagon chief following criticisms regarding the war in Iran. The decision provides a significant political win for President Donald Trump shortly after his party's recent electoral challenges.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት ሪፐብሊካኖች የመከላከያ ሚኒስትሩን ፒት ሄግሴትን በኢራን ጦርነት ምክንያት የመክሰስ ሙከራን አግደዋል። የክስ መዝገቡን ለምክር ቤቱ የፍትህ ኮሚቴ በመምራት ጉዳዩ በጉባኤ ላይ እንዳይወሰን አድርገዋል። ይህ እርምጃ በፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ አስተዳደር ላይ ሊደርስ የነበረውን ጫና በማስወገድ ለፕሬዝዳንቱ የፖለቲካ ድል አስገኝቷል።
oromo: Miseensonni paartii Ripaabilikaanii kan mana maree bakka bu'oota ummataa Ameerikaa, ministira ittisaa Pite Hegeeseet irratti dhiyaate ture itti gaafatamummaa irraa kaasuuf yaalame dhaabsisaniiru. Himannaan kun sagalee mana mareetiin osoo hin ilaalamin gara komitee seeraatti akka darbu godhameera. Tarkaanfiin kun prezidaant Doonaald Tiraampiif injifannoo siyaasaa ta'ee jira.

title: Meghan's father Thomas Markle back in federal custody after allegedly removing ankle monitor
english: Thomas Markle, the father of the Duchess of Sussex, has been returned to federal custody in Florida after authorities accused him of removing his court-ordered ankle monitor. He was recently arrested on charges related to the possession of child sexual abuse material found in storage units. A judge denied his bond and ordered a medical evaluation, citing that his current living arrangements are unsuitable for house detention.
amharic: የዱቼስ ኦፍ ሱሴክስ አባት የሆኑት ቶማስ ማርክል በፍርድ ቤት የታዘዘባቸውን የክትትል መሳሪያ (አንክል ሞኒተር) በማውለቃቸው እንደገና በቁጥጥር ስር ውለዋል። ባለፈው ሳምንት በህጻናት ላይ የሚፈጸም የወሲብ ጥቃት ምስሎችን ይዘዋል በሚል ክስ ተይዘው በቤት ውስጥ እስር እንዲቆዩ ተወስኖባቸው ነበር። አሁን ግን ዳኛው የዋስ መብታቸውን በመከልከልና የጤና ምርመራ እንዲያደርጉ በማዘዝ ወደ እስር ቤት ተመልሰዋል።
oromo: Abbaan Duchess of Sussex, Thomas Markle, meeshaa isaaniin hordofuuf hidhamee ture ofirraa baasuun isaanii erga himatamee booda gara mana hidhaatti deebifamaniiru. Isaanis torban darbe qabeenya suuraa gudeeddii daa'immanii of keessaa qabu jedhamee shakkamee qabamuun isaanii ni yaadatama. Abbaan seeraa tokko mirga wabii isaanii dhowwatee, akkasumas haalli jireenya isaanii mijataa waan hin taaneef qorannoon fayyaa akka godhamuuf ajajaniiru.

title: Malaysia's disgraced former PM leaves jail for house arrest after embezzling millions
english: Former Malaysian Prime Minister Najib Razak has been moved from prison to serve the remainder of his corruption sentence under house arrest at his private residence. He was previously convicted for his central role in the massive 1MDB financial scandal, which involved the theft of billions from a state fund. While a royal pardon allowed for this transition, the decision has drawn criticism from those concerned about the integrity of Malaysia's anti-corruption efforts.
amharic: የማሌዢያ የቀድሞ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ናጂብ ራዛክ በሙስና ወንጀል የተፈረደባቸውን የእስር ጊዜ ቀሪ ክፍል በቤታቸው እንዲያሳልፉ ከእስር ቤት ወደ መኖሪያ ቤታቸው ተዛውረዋል። የቀድሞው መሪ በቢሊዮን የሚቆጠር የአገሪቱን ገንዘብ በማጭበርበር በተከሰሱበት ታዋቂው የ1MDB ቅሌት ጥፋተኛ ተብለው ነበር። ምንም እንኳን ንጉሣዊ ይቅርታ አግኝተው ወደ ቤታቸው ቢመለሱም፣ ይህ ውሳኔ የሙስና መከላከል ጥረትን እንደሚጎዳ በመግለጽ በብዙዎች ዘንድ ትችት አስነስቷል።
oromo: Muummee ministiraa duraanii Maaleeshiyaa Naajiib Raazaak, yakka malaammaltummaa irratti itti murtaa'eef mana hidhaa turan sana xumura isaa mana isaanii keessatti akka dabarsan ajajamee gara manaatti deebi'aniiru. Inni kanaan dura maallaqa biyyattii biliyoonaan lakkaawwamu saamuu isaa irratti shakkamee yakka '1MDB' jedhamuun qabamee ture. Mootichi dhiifama gochuun isaa gara manaatti akka deebi'an hayyamus, murteen kun duula malaammaltummaa balleessuuf godhamu irratti dhiibbaa akka qabu hoggantoonni fi sabaan mormameera.

title: Violence erupts in Bangladesh as ousted PM's supporters stage protest
english: Supporters of Bangladesh's former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina recently held nationwide protests demanding her return from exile in India, leading to violent clashes with security forces. Demonstrators set fire to vehicles and blocked roads, resulting in at least one death and significant travel disruptions. This marks the first major organized demonstration by Hasina's party members since her removal from power in 2024 following widespread public unrest.
amharic: የባንግላዲሽ የቀድሞ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሼክ ሀሲና ደጋፊዎች እርሳቸው ከህንድ በስደት እንዲመለሱ በመጠየቅ በአገሪቱ የተለያዩ አካባቢዎች ተቃውሞ አሰምተዋል። በጸጥታ ሃይሎች እና በተቃዋሚዎች መካከል በተፈጠረ ግጭትም የተሽከርካሪዎች መቃጠልን ጨምሮ ብጥብጥ ተቀስቅሷል፣ ይህም የአንድ ሰው ህይወት እንዲያልፍ ምክንያት ሆኗል። ይህ እ.ኤ.አ. በ2024 ከስልጣን ከተወገዱ በኋላ የፓርቲያቸው ደጋፊዎች ያደረጉት የመጀመሪያው ትልቅ የተደራጀ የተቃውሞ ሰልፍ ነው።
oromo: Deeggartonni ministira muummee durii kan Bangladesh Sheikh Hasina, isaan biyya Hindi irraa gara biyyaatti akka deebi'an gaafachuun magaalonni garaagaraa keessatti hiriira mormii godhaniiru. Hiriirichi gara walitti bu'insa humnoota nageenyaa wajjin godhametti jijjiiramuun, konkolaatonni gubachuu fi namni tokko lubbuun isaa darbuun gabaafameera. Hiriirri kun erga Sheikh Hasina bara 2024 aangoo irraa bu'anii booda, deeggartoota isaaniitiin qindaa'ee kan godhame hiriira gurguddaa jalqabaa ti.

title: Spain's king and queen attend memorial service for rail crash victims
english: King Felipe VI and Queen Letizia of Spain joined grieving families and government officials for a funeral mass honoring the 69 people killed in a recent high-speed train collision near Urda. The accident, which remains under investigation, is the country’s deadliest rail disaster in over a decade and has sparked calls for improved safety standards. During the ceremony, the royal couple offered their condolences to the families of the victims while the nation grapples with the political fallout and ongoing rail safety concerns.
amharic: የስፔኑ ንጉሥ ፊሊፔ ስድስተኛ እና ንግሥት ሌቲዚያ በኡርዳ አቅራቢያ በደረሰው የባቡር አደጋ ሕይወታቸውን ላጡ 69 ሰዎች በተዘጋጀው የጸሎት ሥነ-ሥርዓት ላይ ተገኝተዋል። ከ10 ዓመታት በላይ በስፔን ታሪክ የከፋው ይህ አደጋ በባቡር መስመሩ ደህንነት ላይ ከፍተኛ ስጋት የፈጠረ ሲሆን የምርመራ ሂደቱም ቀጥሏል። የንጉሣዊው ቤተሰብ አባላት ለሟቾች ቤተሰቦች መጽናናትን የተመኙ ሲሆን አገሪቱም በባቡር ትራንስፖርት ደህንነት ጉዳይ ላይ ከፍተኛ ክርክር ውስጥ ትገኛለች።
oromo: Mootichi Ispeen Filiipee VI fi Mootittiin Letiziyaa namoota 69 balaa baaburaa magaala Urdaa biratti dhiheenya kana mudateen lubbuun isaanii darbeef yaadannoo gaggeeffame irratti argamaniiru. Balaan kun waggoota kudhan darbaniif biyyattii keessatti balaa baaburaa cimaa waan ta'eef, dhimmi kun sakatta'iinsa keessa jiraachuun isaa ibsameera. Miseensonni maatii mootummaa maatii miidhamtootaa jajjabeessuun kan dura bu'an yoo ta'u, biyyattis akkaataa nageenya daandii baaburaa fooyyessuun danda'amu irratti marii cimaa keessa jirti.

title: Massive fire as Israeli settlers burn down business near Nablus
english: Israeli settlers recently set fire to a mechanic workshop and a vehicle scrapyard in the Palestinian village of Luban ash-Sharqiya, located near Nablus. Local residents captured footage of the incident as firefighters struggled to extinguish the large blaze. This act of violence has caused significant destruction to the local Palestinian-owned business.
amharic: የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ነዋሪዎች ናብሉስ አቅራቢያ በሚገኘው የሉባን አሽ-ሻርቂያ መንደር የፍልስጤም ንብረት የሆነ የሜካኒክ አውደ ጥናት እና የመኪና መጋዘን በእሳት አቃጠሉ። የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች እሳቱን ለማጥፋት ሲታገሉ በነበሩ የእሳት አደጋ ሠራተኞች ላይ የተቀረጸውን ምስል በቪዲዮ መዝግበዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በባለቤቶቹ ንብረት ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት አስከትሏል።
oromo: Buqqaattoonni Israa'el ganda Lubaan ash-Shaargiyaa kan Naablusitti dhihoo jiru keessatti bakka suphaa konkolaataa fi iddoo kosii konkolaataa kan namoota Falasxiin ta'e ibiddan gubaniiru. Jiraattonni naannichaa yeroo dhaamsiibdonni ibiddaa ibidda kana dhaamsuuf carraaqqii gochaa turan viidiyoodhaan qabataniiru. Gochi kun qabeenya namoota Falasxiin irra miidhaa guddaa geessiseera.

title: French far-right author Zemmour launches second presidential bid
english: Far-right author and political figure Eric Zemmour has officially announced his candidacy for the 2027 French presidential election. He is campaigning on a strict platform that aims to significantly reduce immigration and deport foreign residents who are unemployed or convicted of crimes. Zemmour enters the race as a competitor to Marine Le Pen, who is currently considered the favorite to succeed President Emmanuel Macron.
amharic: የቀኝ ዘመም አቀንቃኙ እና ደራሲው ኤሪክ ዘሙር ለፈረንሳይ የ2027 የፕሬዚዳንታዊ ምርጫ በይፋ እጩ መሆናቸውን አስታውቀዋል። እሳቸው ስደተኞችን ቁጥር በከፍተኛ ደረጃ ለመቀነስ እና ስራ አጥ የሆኑ ወይም በወንጀል የተከሰሱ የውጭ ዜጎችን ከፈረንሳይ ለማባረር ያለመ ጥብቅ መርሃ ግብር ይዘው እየቀረቡ ነው። ዘሙር በምርጫው ከሚወዳደሩት እና በአሁኑ ወቅት የፕሬዚዳንት ኢማኑኤል ማክሮንን ቦታ ይይዛሉ ተብሎ ከሚጠበቁት ማሪን ለፔን ጋር ይፎካከራሉ።
oromo: Barreessaan fi nama siyaasaa mirga-qaxxaamuraa (far-right) kan ta'an Eerik Zeemuur, filannoo pirezidaantummaa Faransaayi kan bara 2027 irratti akka hirmaatan beeksisaniiru. Inni sagantaa baqattoota hir'isuu fi lammiilee biyya alaa hojii dhabanii ykn yakkaan himataman biyyatti ari'uun irratti xiyyeeffatu baasee socho'aa jira. Zeemuur filannoo kana irratti kan dorgomu kanneen akka Maariin Le Peen, kanneen pirezidaant Eemaanu'eel Maakroon bakka bu'uuf carraa guddaa qaban jedhamanii yaadamu waliini.

title: Russia expels Moldovan diplomat in tit-for-tat move
english: Russia has expelled a Moldovan diplomat in a retaliatory move following Moldova's decision to remove a Russian embassy official. This friction stems from Moldova's claim that a Russian drone carrying explosives crashed on its territory, a charge the Kremlin has denied. Tensions between the two nations continue to rise as Moldova actively seeks to reduce its dependency on Russian energy by integrating its power grid with Europe.
amharic: ሞልዶቫ የሩሲያ ኤምባሲ ሰራተኛን ካባረረች በኋላ፣ ሩሲያ በበቀል እርምጃ አንድ የሞልዶቫ ዲፕሎማትን ከሀገር አስወጥታለች። ይህ ውጥረት የተፈጠረው የሞልዶቫ ባለስልጣናት ፈንጂ የያዘ የሩሲያ ድሮን በግዛታቸው ላይ መውደቁን በመግለጻቸው ሲሆን፣ ክሬምሊን ግን ይህንን ክስ አስተባብሏል። ሞልዶቫ የኃይል አቅርቦቷን ከአውሮፓ ጋር በማስተሳሰር ከሩሲያ ያለባትን ጥገኝነት ለመቀነስ በምትጥርበት በዚህ ወቅት በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው ግንኙነት እያሽቆለቆለ መጥቷል።
oromo: Mootummaan Raashiyaa, biyyi Moldoovaa qondaala embaasii Raashiyaa biyyatti ishee baasuu hordofee, gama isaatiin diplomata Moldoovaa tokko biyyattii baaseera. Wal-dhabdeen kun kan uumame, erga mootummaan Moldoovaa xiyyaaraan nama hin qabne kan meeshaa waraanaa baatu tokko biyyatti isaanii irratti kufuusaa ibsee booda. Mootummaan Moldoovaa fedhii isaa kan ta'e humna ibsaa Raashiyaa irraa bilisa ba'uuf adeemsa guddinaa irra kan jiru yoo ta'u, kunis hariiroo biyyoota lamaanii caalaatti hammaachisee jira.

title: US House Republicans reject effort to impeach Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth
english: US House Republicans have blocked an attempt to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, effectively ending efforts to remove him from office. Representative Thomas Massie led the impeachment push, citing concerns over the secretary's role in the Iran war and military strikes conducted without congressional approval. The Republican party majority successfully sidelined the resolution, preventing a formal vote on the charges and shielding the Pentagon chief from immediate repercussions.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት ሪፐብሊካኖች የመከላከያ ሚኒስትሩን ፒት ሄግሴትን በክስ ከስልጣን የማውረድ ጥረትን አግደዋል። የሪፐብሊካን ተወካይ ቶማስ ማሲ ሚኒስትሩ ያለ ህግ አውጪው ፈቃድ ከኢራን ጋር ጦርነት ከፍተዋል በሚል ክሱን መርተውት ነበር። የሪፐብሊካን አባላት በአብላጫ ድምፅ ጉዳዩን ወደ ኮሚቴ በመምራት ውድቅ አድርገውታል፣ ይህም ሄግሴት ከስልጣን እንዳይወገዱ አድርጓል።
oromo: Miseensonni mana maree bakka bu'oota ummataa Ameerikaa (US) kan Ripablikaanotaa, ministeera ittisaa Piit Hegseth aangoo irraa kaasuuf dhihaate ture fashaleessaniiru. Bakka bu'aan Thomas Massie ministeerichi hayyama mana maree malee waraana Iraan waliin geggeesseera jechuun himannaa kana dhiheessanii turan. Haa ta'u malee, miseensonni Ripablikaanotaa hedduun himannicha komitee keessatti qabsiisuun akka hin fudhatamne godhaniiru.

title: UNIFIL patrol comes under fire in southern Lebanon
english: A UN peacekeeping patrol was targeted by gunfire near Wadi Jilu in southern Lebanon, though no injuries were reported. The peacekeepers returned fire and are currently calling for a formal investigation into the incident. This attack highlights ongoing regional instability as the mission's mandate is set to expire at the end of 2026.
amharic: በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በዋዲ ጂሉ አካባቢ የሚንቀሳቀስ የተባበሩት መንግስታት የሰላም አስከባሪ ጦር ጥቃት ደርሶበታል፤ በዕለቱም ምንም አይነት የሰው ህይወት አልጠፋም። የሰላም አስከባሪዎቹ የተኮሱትን በመመለስ ሁኔታውን ያረጋጉ ሲሆን፣ በድርጊቱ ላይ ምርመራ እንዲደረግም ጠይቀዋል። ይህ ጥቃት በክልሉ ያለውን አለመረጋጋት የሚያሳይ ሲሆን፣ የተባበሩት መንግስታት የሰላም አስከባሪ ተልዕኮም በ2026 መጨረሻ ላይ ሊያበቃ ቀጠሮ ተይዞለታል።
oromo: Humnoonni nageenya kabachiistoota tokkummaa mootummootaa kibba Libanon, naannoo Waadii Jiiluu keessatti dhukaasa irratti banamee ture; ta'us miidhaan qaamaa tokko illee hin geenye. Humnoonni kunis dhukaasa deebisanii kan banan yoo ta'u, qorannoon hatattamaa akka gaggeeffamu gaafataniiru. Haleellaan kun tasgabbii dhabuu naannichaa kan agarsiisu yoo ta'u, ergamni nageenya kabachiistota kanaas dhuma bara 2026 akka xumuramuuf karoorfamee jira.

title: US House Democrat leader Jeffries will retain position despite opposition, sources say
english: Hakeem Jeffries is expected to remain the Democratic leader in the U.S. House of Representatives because there are no viable challengers for his role. Although some progressive members and voters are unhappy with his leadership and policy stances, party unity makes it difficult for any opposition to succeed. Consequently, he remains the clear choice to continue guiding the caucus.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት የዴሞክራቶች መሪ ሀኪም ጄፍሪስ፣ ተፎካካሪ ባለመኖሩ ምክንያት በኃላፊነታቸው እንደሚቀጥሉ ይጠበቃል። ምንም እንኳን አንዳንድ የፓርቲው አባላት እና ደጋፊዎች በፖሊሲያቸው ላይ ቅሬታ ቢኖራቸውም፣ በፓርቲው ውስጥ ያለውን ክፍተት ለመሙላት ሌላ አማራጭ መሪ የለም። በዚህም ምክንያት ጄፍሪስ የመሪነቱን ቦታ ይዘው እንደሚቀጥሉ እርግጥ ሆኗል።
oromo: Hakeem Jeffriis hoogganaa paartii Dimokraatawoo kan ta'an, dorgomtoonni hin jiran waan ta'eef bakka isaan jiranitti itti fufuun isaanii mirkanaa'eera. Miseensonni paartichaa fi deggertoonni tokko tokko ilaalcha siyaasaa isaanarratti mormii qabaatanis, bakka bu'aan isaan bakka bu'u garuu hin jiru. Kanaafuu, Jeffriis hoogganaa paartichaa ta'anii itti fufuun isaanii kan hin oolle dha.

title: Japan pledges $1.97m to support Gaza health response
english: Japan has partnered with the World Health Organization to donate nearly $2 million to assist with healthcare services in Gaza. This funding will primarily be used to set up a specialized coordination center for emergency medical teams in Gaza City. The agreement was finalized in Ramallah by representatives from both Japan and the WHO to strengthen the region's medical response capabilities.
amharic: ጃፓን በጋዛ ያለውን የጤና አገልግሎት ለመደገፍ ከዓለም የጤና ድርጅት ጋር በመተባበር ወደ 2 ሚሊዮን የሚጠጋ የአሜሪካ ዶላር እርዳታ ሰጥታለች። ይህ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ በዋናነት በጋዛ ከተማ ለአስቸኳይ ጊዜ የህክምና ቡድኖች የማስተባበሪያ ማዕከል ለማቋቋም ይውላል። ስምምነቱ በሁለቱ አካላት ተወካዮች አማካኝነት በራማላህ የተፈረመ ሲሆን፣ ይህም በክልሉ ያለውን የህክምና አቅም ለማጠናከር ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Japan tajaajila fayyaa Gaazaa keessatti kennamu deeggaruuf Dhaabbata Fayyaa Addunyaa waliin ta'uun doolaara miiliyoona lamaan dhihaatu arjoomteetti. Gargaarsi kun kan oolu beekumsa addaa fi qindoomina garee ogeeyyii yaala ariifachiisaa Gaazaa keessatti dhaabuuf dha. Waliigalteen kun bakka bu'oota gamasii kanaan magaalaa Raamaalaa keessatti kan mallatteeffame yoo ta'u, kaayyoon isaas dandeettii yaala naannichaa guddifachuu dha.

title: US House Democrat leader Jeffries will retain position despite opposition, sources say
english: Hakeem Jeffries is widely expected to remain the leader of the House Democrats and potentially become the next Speaker of the House, despite significant public opposition. Critics argue that he is too closely aligned with corporate interests and pro-Israel lobbying groups, failing to represent the party's progressive base. However, experts suggest that internal party discipline and the symbolic importance of him becoming the first Black Speaker will likely help him secure the position when the vote occurs next week.
amharic: ሃኪም ጄፍሪስ በህዝብ ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ቢገጥመውም፣ በምክር ቤቱ የዴሞክራቶች መሪነቱን እንደሚቀጥል እና ቀጣዩ የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት አፈ-ጉባኤ እንደሚሆን ይጠበቃል። ተቺዎቹ እርሱ ከድርጅቶች እና ከእስራኤል ደጋፊ ቡድኖች ጋር የጠበቀ ግንኙነት ስላለው የፓርቲውን ተራማጅ አቋም እንደማያንጸባርቅ ይከራከራሉ። ሆኖም የፓርቲው የውስጥ ዲሲፕሊን እና የመጀመሪያው ጥቁር አፈ-ጉባኤ የመሆኑ ታሪካዊ ፋይዳ በሚቀጥለው ሳምንት በሚካሄደው ምርጫ ድጋፍ እንዲያገኝ እንደሚረዳው ባለሙያዎች ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Hakeem Jeffries mormii guddaa uummata keessaa jiraatus, hogganaa paartii Dimokiraatotaa ta'ee itti fufuufi kan itti aanu af-yaa'ii Mana Maree Bakka Bu'oota Ummataa ta'uun isaa ni eegama. Komattoonni inni fedhii dhaabbilee gurguddaa fi gareewwan Israa'el deggeran waliin walitti dhufeenya cimaa qabaachuun isaa, yaada paartichaa gara fuulduraa kan hin bakka buune ta'uu dubbatu. Haata'u malee, qajeelfama keessoo paartichaa fi seenaa isa af-yaa'ii gurraacha jalqabaa ta'uuf jiruun walqabatee, sagalee torbee dhufu kennamuun mo'achuuf carraa guddaa akka qabu ogeeyyoonni ni ibsu.

title: Fire breaks out on platform in Iran’s South Pars field
english: A fire occurred on a platform at Iran's South Pars gas field, though authorities confirm the situation is currently under control. While the cause is still being investigated, officials suspect it may have resulted from a gas leak or a technical error. The affected platform represents a very small fraction of the field's total daily gas production.
amharic: በኢራን ሳውዝ ፓርስ የተፈጥሮ ጋዝ ማውጫ ቦታ ላይ ባለው መድረክ ላይ የእሳት አደጋ ተከስቷል፣ ነገር ግን ባለስልጣናት ሁኔታው አሁን ሙሉ በሙሉ በቁጥጥር ስር መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። የእሳቱ መንስኤ በጋዝ መፍሰስ ወይም በቴክኒክ ችግር የተፈጠረ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ቢጠረጠርም ምርመራው ቀጥሏል። ጉዳት የደረሰበት መድረክ ከጠቅላላው የዕለት ምርት ውስጥ በጣም አነስተኛውን ድርሻ ብቻ የሚይዝ ነው።
oromo: Buufata gaazii 'South Pars' kan Iran keessatti bakka gaazii itti baafamu tokko irratti ibiddi ka’ee ture, ta’us abbootiin taayitaa haallichi ammatti to’annoo jala jiraachuu ibsaniiru. Sababiin ibidichaa qulqulleeffamaa kan jiru yoo ta’u, gaazii yaa’uu ykn dogoggora teeknikaatiin ta’uu mala jedhamee shakkama. Buufatni miidhaan irra ga’e kun oomisha gaazii guyyaatti argamu guutuu keessaa hamma baayyee xiqqoo qofa kan qabatu dha.

title: US charges three 'Iranian operatives' over UK air base plot
english: The United States Department of Justice has officially charged three men identified as Iranian operatives for their involvement in a plot to attack the RAF Fairford air base in the United Kingdom. The accused individuals, named Al-Saadi, Mohajeri, and Al-Hassani, are linked to a security incident that occurred at the site last September. This specific base has been utilized by the U.S. military for operations directed at Iran.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፍትህ መምሪያ በእንግሊዝ በሚገኘው የRAF Fairford አየር ማረፊያ ላይ ጥቃት ለመሰንዘር አቅደዋል በተባሉ ሶስት የኢራን ወኪሎች ላይ ክስ መስርቷል። አል-ሳዲ፣ ሞሃጄሪ እና አል-ሀሳኒ የተባሉት ተጠርጣሪዎች ባለፈው መስከረም ወር በዚሁ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ በተፈጠረ የጸጥታ ችግር ውስጥ እጃቸው እንዳለበት ይነገራል። ይህ የአየር ማረፊያ የአሜሪካ ወታደሮች በኢራን ላይ በሚያደርጓቸው ስራዎች ሲጠቀሙበት የቆየ ጣቢያ ነው።
oromo: Manni Maree Haqaa Ameerikaa namoota sadan ergamtoota Iraan jedhaman irratti buufata xiyyaraa RAF Fairford kan biyya Ingiliziirratti haleellaa raawwachuuf karoorfataniiru jechuun himannaa banera. Namoonni himatamanii, Al-Saadi, Mohajeri fi Al-Hassani, ji'a Fulbaana darbe buufata sana keessatti rakkoo nageenyaa uumame waliin wal qabatu. Buufanni kun waraana Ameerikaa kan Iraan irratti duula gaggeessuuf itti fayyadamaa turanidha.

title: Ethiopia’s Intellectual Crisis Begins With a Culture of Conformity
english: The article explores why Ethiopian intellectual life struggles, pointing to a deeply rooted cultural tendency to prioritize conformity over critical thinking. By examining the impact of social conditioning, the author argues that discouraging questioning from childhood creates a system where fear and imitation silence independent voices. Ultimately, the piece suggests that moving forward requires a shift toward valuing innovation and challenging the status quo to ensure the country can learn from its past mistakes.
amharic: ጽሁፉ የኢትዮጵያ ምሁራዊ ህይወት ለምን ለችግር እንደተጋለጠ በመመርመር፣ ለጥያቄዎች ቦታ የማይሰጥና መተግበርን የሚያስቀድም ባህላዊ ተጽዕኖ ዋና ምክንያት እንደሆነ ያብራራል። ከልጅነት ጀምሮ በቤተሰብና በትምህርት ቤት የሚፈጠረው አፈና፣ ሰዎች ነጻ አስተሳሰብን ከመግለጽ እንዲቆጠቡ እንደሚያደርግ ይገልጻል። በመጨረሻም፣ ሀገሪቱ ካለፈችበት ታሪክ እንድትማርና ወደፊት እንድትራመድ፣ የፈጠራ አስተሳሰብን ማበረታታትና የተለመደውን የአመለካከት እስራት መስበር እንደሚያስፈልግ ይጠቁማል።
oromo: Barruun kun jireenyi sammuu fi yaadaa Itoophiyaa maaliif akka guddachuu dadhabe qorata; kunis aadaa gaaffii kaasuuf bakka hin kennine fi namoota hunda hordofanii akka yaadan godhu irraa kan madde akka ta’e ibsa. Ijoollummaadhaa kaasee gaaffii gaafachuu akka hammeenyaatti ilaalun, soda fi amala of qabachuu akka uume dubbata. Dhumarrattis, biyyattiin seenaa ishee irraa barachuu fi gara fuulduraatti tarkaanfachuu akka dandeessuuf, yaada haaraa uumuu fi akkaataa itti yaadamuu keessatti jijjiirama fiduun barbaachisaa ta’uu akeeka.

title: Arrests made in Mohamed Al Fayed probe in France, police say
english: French authorities have conducted searches at properties linked to the late Mohamed Al Fayed, including the Ritz hotel, as part of an investigation into allegations of sexual abuse and human trafficking. During this collaborative operation with British police, several individuals were detained for questioning and subsequently released. Investigators are now analyzing seized digital evidence to advance the ongoing case involving the former Harrods owner.
